assistant: 1. Quick Start 2. FAQ 3. Contact Ususer: Make the second one shorter
✓ 2. FAQ
How old messages enter a new request

The product saves old messages: The chat product can keep the three titles and later replies in its own records.

The application selects relevant parts: For this request, it retrieves the three titles and sends them with the new message.

The model sees only what was sent: If the request contains only “make the second one shorter,” visible UI history cannot resolve the reference.

What people often confuse

Conversation history is what the product has saved. A stateless request still needs the relevant material supplied again. Saved does not mean sent.
